blurb: Guests take an 80-minute guided tour on amphibious vehicles called DUCKs, exploring Boston's historic sites and the Charles River. Tours include narration by ConDUCKtors who point out landmarks such as the Boston Massacre site, Faneuil Hall, State House, Boston Common, and Public Garden. Group tours and charters are available with options for off-site pickup and drop-off.
extraNote: Donation requests for tickets require official letterhead and return address; limited to 2 tickets per request and only to New England organizations · Gratuity/Staff Fee included in group pricing, split between ConDUCKtors and other crew · Tours depart from Museum of Science and Prudential Center locations. · March through November

hours: Tours depart 7 days a week from 9am until an hour before sunset.
